messages.subject: Reading json file using rjson , output only two json array object.
parts:
engine.eval("filename <- 'examplejsontest.json'");
engine.eval("result1 <-rjson::fromJSON(file=filename)");
engine.eval("result2 <- do.call(rbind,lapply(result1,data.frame))");

Above code is giving two rows in result2 object.Please let me know the issue.
